title: Nearest Bathroom from each Desk
description_html:
Given a 2D grid of characters where 'B' = Bathroom, 'D' = Desk, and any other char ('.') = walkable empty space, compute the shortest 4-directional distance from each Desk to its nearest Bathroom.

Return a 2D integer array dist of the same shape:

  • dist[i][j] = shortest distance to any Bathroom when grid[i][j] == 'D';
  • -1 everywhere else;
  • -1 for a Desk that cannot reach any Bathroom.

Example

3 4
..B.
.D..
...D
----
-1 -1 -1 -1
-1  2 -1 -1
-1 -1 -1  3

Constraints: 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 1000; at least one 'D'; number of 'B' may be 0.

See Notes for the approach, how it differs from the textbook versions, and related problems (Refer).
